arStrings.szText: {c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_A_IMPACT}{/c} damage and ricochets to {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} additional target.

{c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} is also a {c_important}Grenade{/c} Skill.

{c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} fires arrows tipped with grenades, causing them to no longer ricochet and instead explode, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_B_IMPACT}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_37}*100|+%|]{/c} increased Cast Speed, and its Energy Cost is reduced to {c_number}{SF_38}{/c}.

{c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_20}*100|%+|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Chance. Each subsequent arrow of {c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} has {c_number}[{SF_19}*100|%+|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Chance, up to {c_number}[{SF_19}*{SF_10}*100|%+|]{/c} on the {c_number}{SF_10}th{/c} arrow.
For each arrow, gain {c_number}[{SF_15}]{/c} Energy when they first hit a {u}{c_important}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} or {u}{c_important}Weakened{/c}{/u} target.
{c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_31} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage per stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} fires {c_number}{SF_32}{/c} additional arrow. Casting {c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} consumes {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} to fire {c_number}{SF_33}{/c} more additional arrow.
